scenario: Comparison operators < > <= >= == != work at runtime per LEXP.4.1. Rules gated on different comparison operators fire for the right facts.
rules_ds:
schema Val scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule low:
    Val x where x.v < 10
->
    log info "low"

rule exact:
    Val x where x.v == 50
->
    log info "exact"

rule high:
    Val x where x.v > 90
->
    log info "high"
